messages.content: Write a 1100–1300 word (REQUIRED) SEO-optimized product review in HTML. Product: {{20.name}} Focus keyword: {{28.result}} Product URL: {{20.permalink}} IMPORTANT OUTPUT RULES - Return ONLY raw HTML. - Do NOT wrap in markdown. - Do NOT use ``` blocks. - Do NOT include explanations. - Generate ONLY the content intended for inside a WordPress post body. - Do NOT include , , , , , or <body>. - Do NOT insert <br> tags. - Do NOT create empty <p> tags. - Start directly with <h1>. SEO RULES - Use semantic HTML: <h1>, <h2>, <h3>, <ul>, <li>, <strong>, <table>. - Keep paragraphs short (2–3 lines). - Use bullet lists for scannability. - Avoid repetitive phrasing. - Write naturally for humans first, SEO second. - Optimize for commercial search intent. KEYWORD RULES - Include the focus keyword in: • the <h1> • the first 100 words • at least 3 <h2> headings • naturally 8–12 times throughout the article - Use keyword variations and related search terms naturally. CONTENT STRUCTURE (MANDATORY) <h1> Use the focus keyword naturally. INTRODUCTION Write an engaging intro explaining what the product is and why people search for it. <h2>What is {{20.name}}?</h2> Explain the product category, brand reputation, and main purpose. <h2>Key Features</h2> List the main features using bullet points. <h2>Technical Specifications</h2> Create a clean HTML table with typical specifications. Use only realistic or commonly known specifications. Do NOT fabricate unrealistic technical details. <h2>Performance and Real-World Usage</h2> Explain how the product performs in real situations. <h2>Benefits of {{20.name}}</h2> Explain practical advantages and use cases. <h2>Pros and Cons</h2> Use bullet lists. <h2>{{20.name}} vs Similar Products</h2> Explain how it compares with similar devices in the same category. <h2>Best Alternatives</h2> Mention 2–3 alternative products in the same category. <h2>Who Should Buy {{20.name}}?</h2> Describe ideal buyers. <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2> Create 4–5 FAQ questions and answers. Each answer should be 40–60 words. <h2>Final Verdict</h2> Summarize the review and recommend the product. CTA RULES - Use EXACTLY this URL: {{20.permalink}} - Do NOT invent links. - Include at least 2 contextual CTA links using anchor text like: "Check the latest price" "See the current deal" "View full product details" - End the article with a strong persuasive call-to-action encouraging the reader to visit the product page.
